scope: One original nonvolatile STORE16 at a fixed own-local frame address; preserve complete backing through splitting and allocation.
implementation_acceptance: One real 16-byte backing passed to a full-width native observer, without a scalar adapter; source and destination evaluated at original points.
exclusions: Loop folding and larger interval unions
Nominal Rust layout or per-output user-type persistence
open_design_gates: Complete bounded consumer read/write/escape contract bound to pointer origin; a raw STORE16 or pointer type alone is insufficient.
Complete post-commit rollback or function reflow clears backing, hints and alias-preservation state together.
